trueREADY_meaning: The bounded textual review evidence is complete and ready for parent consumption after freeze verification. It is not a declaration that every process constraint passed or that SOURCE199, modern FIG, or fullcard is approved.
rules_read: .claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/SKILL.md: original extraction rules and cap3 bitmap tracing

scope.criterion: Independently inspect the manifest-bound RAW and already newly rendered SVG raster, once each. Preserve necessary original structure, visible labels, ray paths, arrowheads, lens/apparatus detail, subfigure counts and connections. No cultural redraw or modern styling rules are applied.
excluded: Whole-page authenticity, SOURCE prose, captions and RAW extraction boundary approval, owned by separate d528
Any repair, new generation, vectorize, finalize, render or native score rerun
Canonical publication, DB access, commit, push or deployment

inputs.binding_method: SHA256 verification of manifest, author freeze and all 12 bound RAW/SVG/preview files before visual inspection, and again at final freeze verification. PNG dimensions are read from headers. SVG output is judged from existing d529 raster pixels, not XML path counts or a native score.

RAW_seen_inventory.basis: Independently recorded from actual open 1, before open 2; no author inventory imported.

items.seen: One large circular outline, nearly full crop width, with a white interior rather than a solid black disc.
Eight dark triangular markers around the inside rim at cardinal and intercardinal positions, pointed inward; short radial tick-like marks lie between them.

Dense horizontal line field occupies the inner circle, shortening toward the top and bottom. A narrow near-vertical central white interruption separates left and right portions; there are short dark strokes in/near that interruption.

A central horizontal paired lobe/eye-shaped form overlays the line field, with dark tapered outer ends, pale inner regions and oblique internal strokes. Left and right pale details remain separate across the central band.

A vertical screw/clamp assembly sits above the circle: irregular dark knob, threaded-looking stem with pale interior slots, and broad pedestal/housing with pale compartments and two dark circular details. Its lower neck meets the top of the circular body.
A long narrow vertical support joins the bottom of the circle and has two dark side boundaries enclosing a pale strip, with a closed lower end.

RAW_seen_inventory.ray_path_statement: This RAW shows a ruled/striped apparatus image, not the separate lens-ray construction of fig-171. No ray endpoints or focal label are invented.
connections: Upper housing neck touches circular rim at top.
Lower support touches circular rim at bottom.
Horizontal line field stays within the circular body.
Central paired lobes share the horizontal center band but retain pale internal spaces.

RAW_seen_inventory.basis: Independently recorded from actual open 7, before open 8; source prose/caption not consulted for this gate.
RAW_seen_inventory.layout: Two separate optical constructions side by side, with a clear gap and separate bottom subfigure glyphs.

items.seen: Left panel has one tall narrow double-convex lens with pointed top/bottom and four internal hatched bands between ray crossings.

Five approximately parallel horizontal tracks come from the left to five heights on the lens; the five outgoing portions meet at a small dark focal node to the right, then fan outward farther right. The middle ray stays approximately horizontal.
Arrowhead profiles on the parallel and fan portions are directed left-to-right.
A small pale opening remains within the dark common node; an italic F sits above that node.
Right panel has one tall narrow double-convex lens, also with four internal hatched bands and pointed ends.

Five approximately parallel horizontal tracks extend on the right of the lens. On its left, the five sloping/middle portions meet at a dark focal node and fan farther left. The common node is to the left of this lens, not on the lens itself.
Arrowhead profiles have the opposite polarity from the left panel, right-to-left: the parallel tracks lead toward the right lens and then toward/through the left focal node.
The dark left-of-lens focal node has a small pale center detail and its own italic F above.

A lower left a-shaped original subfigure glyph and a lower right Cyrillic be-shaped glyph are visible, conventionally transcribed as U+0430 and U+0431. Pixels alone do not distinguish Cyrillic U+0430 from Latin U+0061; this gate verifies glyph preservation, not codepoint transcription.

necessary_labels.position: above the focal node right of the left lens
above the focal node left of the right lens

connections: Left panel: each of five left parallel portions meets its corresponding lens crossing and sloping portion.
Left panel: all five outgoing tracks share the same right-of-lens focal node, then remain five fan portions.
Right panel: each of five right parallel portions meets its corresponding lens crossing and sloping portion.
Right panel: all five left-side tracks share the same left-of-lens focal node, then remain five fan portions.
No ray links the two panels; each F belongs to its own node.

scope_HOLD_policy.meaning: Exact microscopic serration, grain, incidental flecks and single-stroke edge thickness are not certified. Existing raster contours visibly smooth some RAW jaggedness. This does not claim zero pixel difference, does not authorize deleting source marks, and does not withhold the independently observed necessary structural gate.
